key_concepts: Basic needs are things needed to live and survive
Humans need food and water as basic needs
Eating nutritious foods helps keep people healthy
Water is used for daily activities such as cooking, washing, and cleaning
Plants need sunlight, water, and air to grow healthy
Healthy plants have dark-green leaves and sturdy upright stems
Soil is where plants start to grow
Animals need food, water, air, and shelter to survive
Wild animals get their basic needs from their environment
Farm animals and pets are fed and provided basic needs by people
Shelter is important for pets and farm animals
Wild animals should be left in their natural environment
